visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Row and Column Direction
visualizerParams.description: Type a flex container that stacks its items in a column. flex-direction column puts the items one under the other, the default row puts them side by side.
visualizerParams.ghostCode: Home Shop Help

checks.label: The links are stacked
checks.expr: (() => { var a = document.querySelectorAll('.menu a'); return a[0].offsetTop < a[1].offsetTop && a[1].offsetTop < a[2].offsetTop; })()

checks.label: The links have the same left edge
checks.expr: (() => { var a = document.querySelectorAll('.menu a'); return a[0].offsetLeft === a[2].offsetLeft; })()
